parent_objective: freeze matched-budget profile training execution command policy without running training
blocked_by: M2228 admits execution command design but not immediate training
supersedes: manual ad hoc execution of M2227 training commands

public_gates: M2229 must freeze the exact training command source and execution order
M2229 must decide whether to preserve the M2227 frozen training_output_root or rematerialize command paths without changing budgets, profiles, seeds, or actor inputs
M2229 must specify failure behavior for individual seed/profile failures
M2229 must specify post-training artifacts, quality floors, and follow-up audit route
M2229 must not run training, reset, rollout, replay, PPO, measured execution, or policy action
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: freezes execution policy for matched-budget training without producing outcome evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: training command design only; no training rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if execution would require profile-specific budgets or seeds
stop if execution-root handling would invalidate M2227 audit lineage
stop if command design cannot preserve contract and guardrail boundaries
fallback_plan: route to command materialization repair if output-root handling is ambiguous
route to config repair if budget/profile/seed drift is required
route to training execution only after the command design is accepted

training_stage.stage_objective: design matched-budget profile training execution command
admission_evidence: M2228 audits M2227 artifacts as count-, budget-, seed-, contract-, and guardrail-clean
M2228 blocks immediate training and admits command design only
allowed_updates: M2229 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: actual training remains blocked until a separate run milestone

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2229 designs training execution and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2229.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2227 matched-budget configs and M2228 artifact audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Execution design must not imply that any profile will win or that GRU self-ID exists.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prevents ad hoc training by freezing the execution protocol before outcome generation
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: enables clean matched-budget training data collection but produces no result by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2229 cannot choose output-root handling without rematerialization
M2229 would allow direct ranking after training without post-training audit

hypothesis: A safe matched-budget training-execution command can be designed from M2227 artifacts without changing budgets, profiles, seeds, or actor inputs and without running training in the design milestone.
success_criteria: execution command source and run order are explicit
post-training artifacts and quality floors are explicit
no reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: execution design silently changes budgets, profiles, seeds, or actor inputs
execution design leaves output-root handling ambiguous
M2229 admits ranking or paper-level claims directly after training without result audit
decision_rule: M2229 passes if it freezes a safe execution command policy and routes actual training to a separate milestone.
